name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
about: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited is a mass market focused bank in India, catering to financially unserved and underserved segments and committed to building financial inclusion in the country. It started its operations as Ujjivan Financial Services Limited, a Non-Banking Financial Company in 2005 with the mission to provide financial services to the ‘economically active poor’ who were not adequately served by financial institutions. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
Retail Banking: 85% in FY25 vs 89% in FY22 
Treasury: 12% in FY25 vs 9% in FY22
Wholesale Banking: 3% in FY25 vs 2% in FY22 [1] [2]

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.947 Cr.
